handovers.title: Handover and return forms ({{n}})
handovers.photo_retention: The form's photos stay in the contract record for {{years}} years after the company account is closed and are then destroyed; they are not deleted before that.
handovers.signed_photos_locked: The form is signed; the photos are part of what was signed and cannot be changed
handovers.photo_rules: Do not photograph faces, documents or personal belongings. Photos here are taken at handover and return with the unit empty, and a clause in the contract covers them; if the tenant is living in the unit (inspection or maintenance), inform them before taking photos. Photos stay in the contract record for the whole statutory retention period.
handovers.sign_hint: After signing, the form cannot be edited or deleted, and it is stamped with the server time.
handovers.sign_photos: The form has {{n}} photo(s); they stay in the contract record for {{years}} years after the company account is closed and are then destroyed, based on the photography clause in the contract.

declaration.residential: Exempt residential contract — the suggested amount is the installment {{amount}} with no VAT.
declaration.unclassified: Legacy contract without classification — no VAT is computed until it is classified from its card; collection follows the existing path.
declaration.mixed: Mixed contract: exempt share {{percent}}% and VAT on the rest.
declaration.inclusive: {{mixed}}The contract value includes VAT: installment {{amount}} = {{net}} net + {{tax}} VAT — so revenue is less than the installment.
declaration.exclusive: {{mixed}}The contract value excludes VAT: installment {{amount}} + {{tax}} VAT = {{gross}} owed by the tenant — this is the suggestion.
declaration.undeclared: Legacy contract with undeclared VAT inclusion — no VAT is computed until it is declared from its card.
